lead: Mahela Jayawardene is a Sri Lankan cricketer, born on 27 May 1977 in Colombo.
As of 2026, he is 49 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has represented Sri Lanka national cricket team and Sinhalese Sports Club and has been recognised with the Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
The sections that follow break down Mahela Jayawardene's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Mahela Jayawardene — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists cricketer as his main occupation.

On the team sheet, Mahela has been associated with Sri Lanka national cricket team (from 1997 to 2014), Sinhalese Sports Club (from 1995 to 2015), Wayamba cricket team (from 2007 to 2012), Punjab Kings (from 2008 to 2010), Kochi Tuskers Kerala (from 2011 to 2011), Delhi Capitals (from 2012 to 2014), Wayamba United (from 2012 to 2012) and Trinbago Knight Riders (from 2014 to 2014).
He has taken part in 1998 Commonwealth Games.
